topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I can't believe it! You know, we've been chatting online for months, and all this time you've been just a few blocks away? It’s like the universe is playing a really cool, synchronous game with us. I'm jumping at the thought of finally meeting you in person, of taking this quirky, digital friendship out into the real world. Let’s grab a coffee, or check out that bookshop you’re always talking about. I’m telling you, it’s one thing to type “LOL” and another thing entirely to actually laugh together over a stupid joke or a shared memory. This is going to be amazing!
